en: Share the invite link so members can join now. They'll show as pending until the group is verified.

pcm: Share the invite link make members join now. Dem go show as pending till dem verify the group.

en: Sign in with your phone number and password. We'll then send a code to your phone.

ig: Jiri nọmba ekwentị na okwuntughe gị banye. Anyị ga-ezite koodu na ekwentị gị.
